title: Mass of an integer multiplicity current: M_W(τ(M, θ, ξ)) = ∫_{M∩W} θ dH^n (Simon Ch. 6, Remark 3.2(3))
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open and let the IMRep R = (C, θ, ξ) in U represent T ∈ 𝒟_n(U). Then for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P, M_W(T) = R.measure(W) = ∫_{C∩W} θ dH^n, where M_W(T) is Simon's mass (6.2.5) with the Euclidean coefficient norm |·|_E on n-covectors (GeometricCurrentOn.massOn).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W
